fact: The Public Prosecution says criminal judgments are recorded against citizens' national number in its digital systems.

CITC supports integration of the National ID database with external parties including the Labor Permits Department, General Organization for Social Insurance, Ministry of Social Solidarity and Central Bank, and the databases include elections.
The National Elections Authority says voter entries were linked to the national number, and voters are looked up by their 14-digit national number.
Egyptian Tax Authority head Rasha Abdel Aal said its payroll system calculates employment income tax for 12 million state employees by making the salary statement available by national number.
Egypt's National Elections Authority says it updated the voter lists for the 2025 Senate election with a QR code beside each voter's name to verify the correctness of his national number.
Raafat Shafik of the Ministry of Social Solidarity says the national social registry of 13 million households is linked to 27 government databases through the national ID number.

The head of the Egyptian Tax Authority said that from 15 December 2024 every employer must file monthly payroll data on the wage and salary tax system, listing each employee's national number, insurance number and gross salary, under Finance Minister decision 386 of 2023.
